author: GitHub
description:
Learn how to go from an open GitHub issue to a pull request using GitHub Copilot inside JetBrains IntelliJ. In this walkthrough, we install the plugin and walk through an end-to-end workflow. Watch how you can use all your favorite GitHub Copilot features in IntelliJ. Visit https://gh.io/copilotinjetbrains to install the plugin and start building today. 

— CHAPTERS —  

00:00 Introduction 
00:29 Installing Copilot in IntelliJ IDEA and finding issues 
01:11 Planning the solution with plan mode 
02:35 Exploring Copilot agent harness & models 
03:23 Copilot implements accessibility fix 
04:32 Reviewing changes with Ask mode 
05:05 Validating accessibility with voiceover 
05:57 Creating pull request & conclusion
